title: Posterior samples and outputs for: Rankings Transfer but Base Rates Do Not - Leave-One-Sector-Out Evaluation of a Prospectivity Model along the Central African Copperbelt
description:
Posterior samples (ArviZ NetCDF traces) and the concatenated held-out predictions that accompany the code repository for Paper 1. They are too large for the Git repository. Each zip archive keeps repository-relative paths: unzip it at the repository root to restore the files in place, then verify them with the checksum manifests in the repository (paper_1/transfer/checksums/SHA256SUMS, paper_1/v15/checksums/SHA256SUMS_v15, the Phase 2b and 2c SHA256SUMS files, and paper_1/benchmark/SHA256SUMS_external). CONTENTS.sha256 lists every file in the archives and ARCHIVES.sha256 lists the archives themselves.

traces_transfer.zip holds the 106 Markov chain Monte Carlo fits of the geographic-transfer analysis reported in the paper. traces_domain_models.zip and traces_v14_distance_sensitivity.zip hold the traces of the earlier domain-model analyses summarized in the supplementary material.

The source products (USGS Central African Copperbelt occurrence compilation, WGM2012 Bouguer gravity, Africa surficial lithology) are not redistributed.
